missing_evidence: Redis server-side latency/error metrics for reserve_inventory during the incident window
candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations from inventory time out (~2s), causing inventory POST /v1/reservations to return 503, order POST /v1/orders to fail with transport ReadTimeout, and gateway POST /v1/checkout to return 502 across all correlated traces.
candidates.uncertainty: No Redis-side metrics or logs are present; the timeout is inferred from client spans only.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timing out with DependencyUnavailable, cascading to inventory 503, order transport ReadTimeout, and gateway 502 on /v1/checkout; topology confirms inventory->redis. Gateway metrics show elevated checkout p95 (~2387ms) and 502s. Bounded candidate is redis-timeout.
